name: Fine Organic Industries Ltd
about: Fine Organic Industries is engaged in and outside India as manufacturers, processors, suppliers, distributors, dealers, importers, exporters of wide range of oleochemical-based additives used in foods, plastics, cosmetics, coatings and other specialty application in various industries.
keyPoints: Product Portfolio:[1] a) Polymer Additives: Lubricants, anti-fogging agents, anti-static additives, slip additives, processing aids, and dispersants. b) Food Additives: Emulsifiers, anti-fungal agents, beverage clouding agents, anti-crystallizers, etc. c) Feed Nutrition Additives: Natural antibiotics, nutritional additives, and anti-fungal agents. d) Personal Care Ingredients: Emollients, emulsifiers, green surfactants. e) Specialty Additives: Wetting agents, dispersants, anti-corrosive additives, emulsifiers.
pros: Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 19.5%

announcements.text: Intimation Under Regulation 30 Of The SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015 6 Nov - Maharashtra GST search concluded; Rs 5.00 crore tax and interest liability paid.
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release 3 Nov - Q2/H1 FY27 results; acquired 80% of Oleofine Organics for ₹80.17 crore and infused ₹55 crore in SEZ subsidiary.

Standalone And Consolidated Un Audited Financial Results For The Quarter And Half Year Ended September 30, 2026 2 Nov - Board approved Q2 FY27 results and raised SEZ subsidiary investment limit by Rs.120 crore to Rs.420 crore.
